summary: The StudentOrientation module manages details associated with student orientations including creation, updating, and searching procedures for orientation records.
purpose: To facilitate the management and retrieval of student orientation details in the HSPnet system.

workflows.name: Add Student Orientation
steps: Parse agencySiteID to get agencyID and siteID.
Add parameters: SessionID, StudentID, AgencyID, SiteID, ProviderTypeCodeID, ContentSource, Location, OrientationDate, Comments, ProviderTypeDescription, StaffID.

workflows.name: Update Student Orientation
steps: Parse agencySiteID to get agencyID and siteID.
If agencyID is 0, add warning and set hasMessage to true.
If noError is true, proceed with update.
Add parameters: SessionID, ID, AgencyID, SiteID, ProviderTypeCodeID, ContentSource, Location, OrientationDate, Comments, ProviderTypeDescription.

workflows.name: Search Student Orientation by ID
steps: Fill list with data from reader.

business_rules: Do not run query in StudentDetailsOrientationSearchID if ID is not greater than 0.
calculations: Truncate Comments to 20 characters for CommentsTruncated field.
conditions: If agencyID is 0 during update, raise warning and flag as message.
system_behavior: Override min date with null if returned in OrientationDate.
exceptions: No update on students with blank Provider.
